reading.body:
The CyrusOne Aurora campus spans three collocated facilities with 114 MW of published IT capacity and 450,000 square feet of technical space, sufficient for approximately 2,850 racks at the 40 kW per-rack standard for AI training workloads.

This campus holds 48 percent of Illinois's 236 MW of publicly disclosed data center IT capacity across six facilities. The remaining 44 mapped data centers in the state publish no capacity figures, making the full scale of Illinois infrastructure invisible. Even Aurora's size is modest against the largest regional AI clusters in other states.

For AI deployment, 114 MW can house a meaningful training operation but not a hyperscale frontier installation. The data does not cover power availability, grid interconnection, tenant occupancy, or power purchase terms at Aurora. Without these, actual utilization and headroom for expansion remain unknown. Suitability for AI scaling depends on factors not published here.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
